crosswalks.label: Information Security Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: O*NET includes response to computer security breaches within Information Security Analysts, grounding part of incident-response work.

crosswalks.label: Incident Response
crosswalks.rationale: NICE current components provide incident-response task/knowledge/skill context; organizational command authority remains separate.

findings.summary: Incident Response must preserve incident-state uncertainty and integrate response/recovery with broader risk management while separating service recovery, eradication, forensics, privacy and risk acceptance.
findings.rationale: Research-backed boundary is compiled into package-local machinery.

gaps_against_body.description: Make suspected-versus-confirmed, containment authority and recovery-versus-resolution boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Incident Response Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No technical access, package construction, role label, model capability or repository permission creates legal, security, safety, privacy, risk, product or institutional authority.
